arguments.analyst: Observed high brightness in O1–O3 despite different edits; prioritize single or small substitutions, avoiding combinations implicated in low O4/O5. Candidate estimates are predictions only.
arguments.hypothesis: Small-effect substitutions or compact combinations can retain high avGFP brightness; the high measured O1/O2 support targeted changes, while the four-edit O4/O5 sequences show that some multi-edit combinations can sharply reduce brightness.

decision.analyst: Observed high brightness in O1–O3 despite different edits; prioritize single or small substitutions, avoiding combinations implicated in low O4/O5. Candidate estimates are predictions only.
decision.hypothesis: Small-effect substitutions or compact combinations can retain high avGFP brightness; the high measured O1/O2 support targeted changes, while the four-edit O4/O5 sequences show that some multi-edit combinations can sharply reduce brightness.
decision.critic: All tool values are fitted predictions, not measured fluorescence; O1–O3 are the only high-brightness observations cited, and they do not establish these candidates’ effects. The predictions are tightly clustered for four candidates, so their relative ranking is weakly supported.
decision.selection_rationale: Test C36, C03, C05, and C27 first: each has a tool estimate near 3.67, and each makes one substitution. Put C14 fifth: its two substitutions have a lower estimate of about 3.58. This prioritizes the highest predictions and simpler edits, but the observed high-brightness variants have different substitutions, so transfer to these designs is uncertain.
